selection: One recorded native macOS runner, or the latest available matching iPhone/iPad simulator on that runner; the concrete destination and runtime are retained.
budget_basis: Limits are declared before measurement. Numeric evaluation requires verified native metric units and positive frame coverage.
limits: Original seven shelf UI cases remain unchanged and are executed separately.
XCTest animation aggregates do not provide a per-frame P95/P99 distribution.
Simulator and hosted macOS results are tied to the recorded runner and device profile.
Reader-body scroll, locate/jump and page/font metrics are not covered by this shelf lane.
